headline: Binance Suffers $6.3 Billion Hack Amid Rising AI-Driven Cyberattacks
summary: Binance experienced a $6.3 billion cyber heist, marking the largest hack in history as attackers increasingly leverage artificial intelligence and advanced techniques.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Major exchange exploits can dampen wider crypto market sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A multi-billion-dollar exploit on a major platform heightens security and regulatory concerns across the digital asset sector, pressuring crypto market sentiment.
